name: Stray Tekirs
storyline:
100 tabbies in every city. Keep your eyes wide open.

Stray Tekirs is a peaceful and attention-focused hidden object game where you search for tabby cats hidden within abstract cityscapes.
Each scene is filled with intricately designed buildings and objects — sometimes a flick of an ear or the curve of a tail might give a cat away.

️ Abstract city silhouettes inspired by real-world cities
100 different tabby cats hidden in each map
⏱️ Race against the clock or explore at your own pace – it’s up to you
Simple, calm, relaxing, and sometimes challenging experience

Stay sharp — some tabbies are really well hidden.
summary: Simple, minimal, and sometimes challenging hidden object game where you search for cats hidden in abstract city maps
